sre-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (SEV2) - eu-central-1 auth token service is returning intermittent 502/503 for hosted API token exchanges. Early impact estimate: ~5% of token requests, some downstream 401s for short-lived sessions. Investigating.

joel (oncall): oncall here, paging auth + edge. seeing spikes in token-issuance latency and upstream 502s. grabbing logs.

tara (auth): noted a surge in token refresh traffic starting 09:02 UTC from a PLG client campaign. token-mint service thread-pool exhausted; queueing causing upstream timeouts.

li (edge): edge-proxy logs show many upstream reset errors to token-mint cluster:
```
# tail -n 20 /var/log/edge/proxy.log | grep token-mint | tail -n 10
"POST /v1/auth/token" 502 0.134s
"POST /v1/auth/refresh" 504 0.300s
```

joel (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) shed non-critical PLG token refresh traffic with a 429 short-circuit, 2) scale token-mint pool by +40% in eu-central, 3) enable short-circuit cache for refreshes with 5s TTL for identical client tokens. Doing 1 now.

nora (support): status draft: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/211111 - "Investigating auth token failures in EU-CENTRAL affecting hosted API sessions. Engineering mitigation in progress." Posting to customers.

tara (auth): scaling token-mint group up; new instances coming online. also applying quick patch to increase thread-pool limit and reject long-running requests earlier.

li (edge): PLG short-circuit deployed to 15% of edge nodes. observed immediate drop in token-mint ingress on canary.

infra-bot: metric snapshot: token_mint_queue_depth eu-central 5m avg: 320 -> 42 after canary; token_5xx rate 5.1% -> 0.8% on canary.

joel (oncall): rolling the PLG short-circuit to 100%, scaling complete. monitoring for downstream 401s and client errors.

nora (support): CS update: majority of customers recovered, a handful of long-lived sessions need manual refresh; enterprise contacts notified and offered a support runbook.

tara (auth): patched token-mint to add bounded work-queue and backpressure signals to callers. will follow up with PR + tests. Action items: add rate-limiter per API key, add autoscale trigger on queue depth, and add short-circuit cache for hot refresh patterns.

status-bot: Incident update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/211111 - "Mitigation applied; partial recovery observed; engineering verification ongoing."

joel (oncall): RESOLVED at 2026-12-09T09:26:40Z. Token exchanges and session refreshes returned to baseline; creating RCA thread and follow-up tasks. :white_check_mark:
